title: Disease models and study expertise across six therapeutic areas
excerpt: Validated rodent models and study designs for PK/PD, gene therapy, autoimmune and metabolic disease, inflammation and fibrosis, and oncology. Each area is led by a senior scientist who has published in it or run it for years.

title: Preclinical in vivo research, with every support service under one roof
excerpt: From formulation and dosing to surgery, imaging and laboratory analysis, the work behind your study happens in our Worcester facility, run by the people who designed it.

title: Tumor models for in vivo oncology efficacy studies
excerpt: Syngeneic and xenograft models run by scientists who have designed oncology studies for decades, with tumor burden tracked by caliper and by bioluminescent IVIS imaging.

title: A preclinical partner built by people who've run the studies
excerpt: Alpha Preclinical is a US-owned discovery research company in Worcester, Massachusetts. We were founded in 2020 by scientists and technicians who spent decades in pharma, biotech and contract research.

title: Peer-reviewed research from the Alpha team
excerpt: Sixteen papers from Alpha scientists and their collaborators on rodent disease models, mRNA delivery, anesthesia and gene regulation.

title: The people who run your studies
excerpt: Every member of our founding team has worked in preclinical research for years before Alpha. When you call us, you talk to the people doing the work.

title: Do research that helps new therapies reach the clinic
excerpt: Join a small, experienced team where your work shapes real drug development programs, and where you learn from scientists with decades in the field.

title: Let's talk about your next study
excerpt: Tell us about your compound, target and timeline. A member of our scientific team will follow up to scope the study and prepare a design and quote.

title: Notes from the vivarium
excerpt: Practical guidance on study design, model selection and preclinical readouts, written by the scientists who run Alpha's studies.

title: Privacy policy
excerpt: How Alpha Preclinical collects, uses and protects information you share with us through this website.

title: Accessibility statement
